patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed hero image with a large, centered aspirational heading, followed by sections that alternate between large text blocks and multi-column image grids.
A sophisticated pairing of an oversized, elegant serif font for display headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation creates a luxurious yet legible hierarchy.
A deep, rich forest green (#10312b) serves as the primary brand color for text and background elements, contrasted with ample white space and natural tones from high-quality photography.
The hero background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a subtle parallax effect, while the main navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are introduced by large, centered, single-line headings, often preceded by a small, uppercase label, providing clear visual breaks and a sense of editorial pacing.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large background image that scrolls at a slower speed than the page content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility as the user scrolls. Subsequent content sections simply reveal by scrolling into view without additional complex animations, relying on the page's natural scroll behavior for content progression.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with small, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements and images featuring crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous vertical padding between sections and ample white space around content blocks, contributing to a luxurious and uncluttered aesthetic.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with an exceptionally refined and editorial aesthetic, driven by the elegant pairing of a classic serif display font with a modern sans-serif. The high-quality, aspirational photography is seamlessly integrated, and the deep forest green brand color provides a unique, sophisticated anchor against the otherwise minimal palette. If a builder copied one idea, it should be the sophisticated typography and color palette that elevates the brand's perceived luxury.
